//\n// Copyright 2017 Valve Corporation. All rights reserved. Subject to the following license:\n// https://valvesoftware.github.io/steam-audio/license.html\n//\n\n#pragma OPENCL EXTENSION cl_khr_int64_extended_atomics : enable \n#pragma OPENCL EXTENSION cl_khr_byte_addressable_store : enable\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Constants\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#define PI                          3.14159f\n\n#define ENABLE_SOURCE_RADIANCE_CHECK\n#define ENABLE_SOURCE_SPHERE_OCCLUSION\n#define ENABLE_LISTENER_SPHERE_OCCLUSION\n#define ENABLE_LISTENER_HEAD_FADE\n\n#define SOURCE_RADIUS   0.1f\n#define LISTENER_RADIUS 0.1f\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CoordinateSpace\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ntypedef struct __attribute__((packed)) CoordinateSpace_t\n{\n    float3 right, up, ahead;\n    float3 origin;\n} CoordinateSpace;\n\nCoordinateSpace tangentSpaceForNormal(float3 normal)\n{\n    CoordinateSpace space;\n    space.ahead = normal;\n\n    if (fabs(normal.x) > fabs(normal.z))\n    {\n        float3 right = (float3) (-normal.y, normal.x, 0.0f);\n        space.right = normalize(right);\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        float3 right = (float3) (0.0f, -normal.z, normal.y);\n        space.right = normalize(right);\n    }\n\n    space.up = cross(space.right, space.ahead);\n\n    return space;\n}\n\nfloat3 transformDirectionFromLocalToWorld(CoordinateSpace space, float3 direction)\n{\n    return direction.x * space.right + direction.y * space.up - direction.z * space.ahead;\n}\n\nfloat3 transformDirectionFromWorldToLocal(CoordinateSpace space, float3 direction)\n{\n    float3 transformedDirection;\n    transformedDirection.x = dot(direction, space.right);\n    transformedDirection.y = dot(direction, space.up);\n    transformedDirection.z = -dot(direction, space.ahead);\n    return transformedDirection;\n}\n\nfloat3 transformHemisphereSample(float3 direction, float3 normal)\n{\n    CoordinateSpace tangentSpace = tangentSpaceForNormal(normal);\n    return normalize(transformDirectionFromLocalToWorld(tangentSpace, direction));\n}\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Random Sampling\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// The following code is from the Radeon Rays / Baikal GitHub repository. It can be found at:\n//      https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/RadeonProRender-Baikal/blob/master/Baikal/Kernels/CL/sampling.cl\n\ntypedef struct Rng_t\n{\n    uint    value;\n} Rng;\n\nuint wangHash(uint seed)\n{\n    seed = (seed ^ 61) ^ (seed >> 16);\n    seed *= 9;\n    seed = seed ^ (seed >> 4);\n    seed *= 0x27d4eb2d;\n    seed = seed ^ (seed >> 15);\n    return seed;\n}\n\nuint randUint(local Rng* rng)\n{\n    rng->value = wangHash(1664525U * rng->value + 1013904223U);\n    return rng->value;\n}\n\nfloat randFloat(local Rng* rng)\n{\n    return ((float)randUint(rng)) / 0xffffffffU;\n}\n\nvoid initRng(uint seed, local Rng* rng)\n{\n    rng->value = wangHash(seed);\n}\n\nfloat2 uniformRandom2d(local Rng* rng)\n{\n    return (float2) (randFloat(rng), randFloat(rng));\n}\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Directivity\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ntypedef struct __attribute__((packed)) Directivity_t\n{\n    float dipoleWeight;\n    float dipolePower;\n    // NOTE: Custom directivity callbacks are not supported at this time.\n} Directivity;\n\ntypedef struct __attribute__((packed)) Source_t\n{\n    CoordinateSpace coordinates;\n    Directivity     directivity;\n} Source;\n\nfloat evaluateDirectivity(float3 point, CoordinateSpace coordinates, Directivity directivity)\n{\n    float3 worldSpaceDirection = normalize(point - coordinates.origin);\n    float3 localSpaceDirection = transformDirectionFromWorldToLocal(coordinates, worldSpaceDirection);\n\n    float cosine = -localSpaceDirection.z;\n    return pow(fabs((1.0f - directivity.dipoleWeight) + directivity.dipoleWeight * cosine), directivity.dipolePower);\n}\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Material\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ntypedef struct __attribute__((packed)) Material_t\n{\n    float  absorptionLow;\n    float  absorptionMid;\n    float  absorptionHigh;\n    float  scattering;\n    float  transmissionLow;\n    float  transmissionMid;\n    float  transmissionHigh;\n} Material;\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Radeon Rays Helpers\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// This must exactly match the ray data structure (struct ray) used by Radeon Rays.\ntypedef struct Ray_t\n{\n    float4  o;\n    float4  d;\n    int2    extra;\n    int2    padding;\n} Ray;\n\n// This must exactly match the hit data structure (struct Intersection) used by Radeon Rays.\ntypedef struct Hit_t\n{\n    int       shapeid;\n    int       primid;\n    int       padding0;\n    int       padding1;\n    float4    uvwt;\n} Hit;\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// IIR Filtering\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ntypedef struct IIR_t\n{\n    float a1, a2;\n    float b0, b1, b2;\n} IIR;\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Ray Generation Kernels (Occlusion)\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nkernel void generateVolumetricOcclusionRays(float3 listener, float3 source, float sourceRadius, \n                                            global float4* sourceSamples, global Ray* listenerRays, \n                                            global Ray* sourceRays)\n{\n    size_t index = get_global_id(0);\n\n    float3 sample = source + (sourceRadius * sourceSamples[index].xyz);\n\n    listenerRays[index].o = (float4) (listener, distance(sample, listener));\n    listenerRays[index].d = (float4) (normalize(sample - listener), 0.0f);\n    listenerRays[index].extra = (int2) (0xffffffff, 1);\n\n    sourceRays[index].o = (float4) (source, distance(sample, source));\n    sourceRays[index].d = (float4) (normalize(sample - source), 0.0f);\n    sourceRays[index].extra = (int2) (0xffffffff, 1);\n}\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Ray Generation Kernels (Reflection)\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nkernel void generateCameraRays(float3 eye, float3 ahead, float3 up, float3 right, global Ray* rays)\n{\n    uint width = get_global_size(0);\n    uint height = get_global_size(1);\n    uint u = get_global_id(0);\n    uint v = get_global_id(1);\n    uint index = v * width + u;\n\n    float du = ((u / (float) width) - 0.5f) * 2.0f;\n    float dv = ((v / (float) height) - 0.5f) * 2.0f;\n\n    rays[index].o = (float4) (eye, FLT_MAX);\n    rays[index].d = (float4) (normalize(du * right + dv * up - ahead), 0.0f);\n    rays[index].extra = (int2) (0xffffffff, 1);\n}\n\nkernel void generateListenerRaysForVisualization(float3 listener, global Ray* rays)\n{\n    uint width = get_global_size(0);\n    uint height = get_global_size(1);\n    uint u = get_global_id(0);\n    uint v = get_global_id(1);\n    uint index = v * width + u;\n\n    float r1 = (float) u / (float) width;\n    float r2 = (float) v / (float) height;\n\n    float phi = r1 * 2.0f * PI;\n    float theta = asin(2.0f * r2 - 1.0f);\n\n    rays[index].o = (float4) (listener, FLT_MAX);\n    rays[index].d = (float4) (-cos(theta) * sin(phi), sin(theta), -cos(theta) * cos(phi), 0.0f);\n    rays[index].extra = (int2) (0xffffffff, 1);\n}\n\nkernel void generateListenerRays(global float3* positions, global float4* sphereSamples, global Ray* rays)\n{\n    size_t rayIndex = get_global_id(0);\n    size_t listenerIndex = get_global_id(1);\n    size_t index = listenerIndex * get_global_size(0) + rayIndex;\n\n    float3 direction = sphereSamples[rayIndex].xyz;\n\n    rays[index].o = (float4) (positions[listenerIndex], FLT_MAX);\n    rays[index].d = (float4) (direction, 0.0f);\n    rays[index].extra = (int2) (0xffffffff, 1);\n}\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Reflected Ray Generation Kernels\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#define SPEED_OF_SOUND              340.0f\n#define RAY_SURFACE_OFFSET          1e-2f\n\nfloat3 calculateHitPoint(Ray ray, Hit hit)\n{\n    return ray.o.xyz + hit.uvwt.s3 * ray.d.xyz;\n}\n\nfloat3 calculateHitNormal(Ray ray, Hit hit, global float4* normals)\n{\n    float3 hitNormal = normals[hit.primid].xyz;\n    if (dot(hitNormal, ray.d.xyz) > 0.0f)\n        hitNormal = -hitNormal;\n    return hitNormal;\n}\n\nfloat3 reflect(float3 incident, float3 normal)\n{\n    return normalize(incident - (2.0f * dot(incident, normal) * normal));\n}\n\nkernel void generateShadowRays(global Ray* rays, global Hit* hits, uint numSources, global Source* sources, \n    global uchar* activeSources, global Ray* shadowRays)\n{\n    size_t shadowRayIndex = get_global_id(0);\n    size_t numRays = get_global_size(0) / numSources;\n    size_t sourceIndex = shadowRayIndex / numRays;\n\n    if (activeSources[sourceIndex] == 0) {\n        shadowRays[shadowRayIndex].extra = (int2) (0x00000000, 0);\n    } else {\n        int rayIndex = shadowRayIndex % numRays;\n\n        float3 hitPoint = calculateHitPoint(rays[rayIndex], hits[rayIndex]);\n\n        shadowRays[shadowRayIndex].d = (float4) (normalize(sources[sourceIndex].coordinates.origin.xyz - hitPoint), 0.0f);\n        shadowRays[shadowRayIndex].o = (float4) (hitPoint + RAY_SURFACE_OFFSET * shadowRays[shadowRayIndex].d.xyz,\n            distance(hitPoint, sources[sourceIndex].coordinates.origin.xyz));\n        shadowRays[shadowRayIndex].extra = (int2) (0xffffffff, (hits[rayIndex].primid >= 0) ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n}\n\nkernel void generateSecondaryRays(global Ray* rays, global Hit* hits, global float4* normals, \n                                  global int* materialIndices, global Material* materials,\n                                  global float4* diffuseSamples, uint numSamples, uint random, \n                                  global float4* accumulatedEnergy, global float* accumulatedDelay,\n                                  global Ray* secondaryRays)\n{\n    size_t index = get_global_id(0);\n\n    local Rng rng;\n    initRng(random + index, &rng);  \n\n    uint sampleIndex = randUint(&rng) % numSamples;\n\n    float3 hitPoint = calculateHitPoint(rays[index], hits[index]);\n\n    float3 hitNormal = calculateHitNormal(rays[index], hits[index], normals);\n\n    float4 hitMaterial = (float4) (materials[materialIndices[hits[index].primid]].absorptionLow, \n                                   materials[materialIndices[hits[index].primid]].absorptionMid,\n                                   materials[materialIndices[hits[index].primid]].absorptionHigh, \n                                   materials[materialIndices[hits[index].primid]].scattering);\n\n    accumulatedDelay[index] += hits[index].uvwt.w / SPEED_OF_SOUND;\n    accumulatedEnergy[index] *= ((float4) 1.0f - hitMaterial);\n\n    if (randFloat(&rng) < hitMaterial.s3)\n    {\n        float3 diffuseSample = transformHemisphereSample(diffuseSamples[sampleIndex].xyz, hitNormal);\n        secondaryRays[index].d = (float4) (diffuseSample, 0.0f);\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        secondaryRays[index].d = (float4) (reflect(rays[index].d.xyz, hitNormal), 0.0f);\n    }\n\n    secondaryRays[index].o = (float4) (hitPoint + RAY_SURFACE_OFFSET * secondaryRays[index].d.xyz, FLT_MAX);\n    secondaryRays[index].extra = (int2) (0xffffffff, rays[index].extra.y & ((hits[index].primid >= 0) ? 1 : 0));\n}\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Shading Kernel\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#define SPECULAR_EXPONENT           1e+2f\n#define VISUALIZATION_SCALE         500.0f\n\nkernel void shade(global Ray* rays, global Hit* hits, global Ray* shadowRays, uint numSources,\n    global Source* sources, global uchar* activeSources, global float4* normals, global int* materialIndices, \n    global Material* materials, global float4* accumulatedEnergy, global float* accumulatedDelay, float3 listener, \n    global float4* image, global float4* totalEnergy, global float* totalDelay)\n{\n    size_t shadowRayIndex = get_global_id(0);\n    size_t numRays = get_global_size(0) / numSources;\n    size_t sourceIndex = shadowRayIndex / numRays;\n    size_t rayIndex = shadowRayIndex % numRays;\n\n    if (activeSources[sourceIndex] == 0 || hits[rayIndex].primid < 0) {\n        totalEnergy[shadowRayIndex] = 0.0f;\n        totalDelay[shadowRayIndex] = 0.0f;\n    } else {\n        float3 hitPoint = calculateHitPoint(rays[rayIndex], hits[rayIndex]);\n        float3 hitNormal = calculateHitNormal(rays[rayIndex], hits[rayIndex], normals);\n        Material hitMaterial = materials[materialIndices[hits[rayIndex].primid]];\n\n        float diffuseTerm = (1.0f / PI) * hitMaterial.scattering * \n            max(0.0f, dot(hitNormal, shadowRays[shadowRayIndex].d.xyz));\n\n        float3 halfVector = normalize(shadowRays[shadowRayIndex].d.xyz - rays[rayIndex].d.xyz);\n        float specularTerm = ((SPECULAR_EXPONENT + 2.0f) / (8.0f * PI)) * (1.0f - hitMaterial.scattering) * \n            pow(fabs(dot(halfVector, hitNormal)), SPECULAR_EXPONENT);\n\n        float directivityTerm = evaluateDirectivity(hitPoint, sources[sourceIndex].coordinates, \n            sources[sourceIndex].directivity);\n\n        float distanceTerm = 1.0f / (4.0f * PI * shadowRays[shadowRayIndex].o.w * shadowRays[shadowRayIndex].o.w);\n\n        float4 hitMaterialCoefficients = (float4) (hitMaterial.absorptionLow, hitMaterial.absorptionMid, \n            hitMaterial.absorptionHigh, hitMaterial.scattering);\n\n        float4 energy = distanceTerm * directivityTerm * (diffuseTerm + specularTerm) * accumulatedEnergy[rayIndex] * \n            (float4) (1.0f - hitMaterialCoefficients);\n\n        float delayTerm = (hits[rayIndex].uvwt.w + shadowRays[shadowRayIndex].o.w) / SPEED_OF_SOUND;\n\n        totalEnergy[shadowRayIndex] = ((4.0f * PI) / numRays) * energy;\n        totalDelay[shadowRayIndex] = delayTerm + accumulatedDelay[rayIndex] - (distance(sources[sourceIndex].coordinates.origin.xyz, listener) / SPEED_OF_SOUND);\n    }\n}\n\nfloat pointSourceIrradiance(float distance,\n                            float minDistance)\n{\n    float attenuation = 1.0f / max(distance, minDistance);\n    float irradiance = (1.0f / (4.0f * PI)) * (attenuation * attenuation);\n    return irradiance;\n}\n\nfloat raySphereIntersect(global Ray const* ray,\n                         const float3 center,\n                         const float radius)\n{\n    float3 origin = ray->o.xyz;\n    float3 direction = ray->d.xyz;\n\n    float3 v = origin - center;\n    float r = radius;\n\n    float B = 2.0f * dot(v, direction);\n    float C = dot(v, v) - (r * r);\n    float D = (B * B) - (4.0f * C);\n\n    if (D < 0.0f)\n        return FLT_MAX;\n\n    float t = -0.5f * (B + sqrt(D));\n    return t;\n}\n\nkernel void sphereOcclusion(global Ray* rays,\n                            global Hit* hits,\n                            uint numListeners,\n                            global float3 const* listeners,\n                            uint numActiveSources,\n                            global int const* activeSourceIndices,\n                            global Source const* sources)\n{\n    uint numRays = get_global_size(0);\n    uint rayIndex = get_global_id(0);\n\n#ifdef ENABLE_SOURCE_SPHERE_OCCLUSION\n    for (int i = 0; i < numListeners; ++i)\n    {\n        uint index = i * numRays + rayIndex;\n        for (int j = 0; j < numActiveSources; ++j)\n        {\n            int sourceIndex = activeSourceIndices[j];\n            float sourceSphereHitDistance = raySphereIntersect(&rays[index], sources[sourceIndex].coordinates.origin.xyz, SOURCE_RADIUS);\n            if (0.0f <= sourceSphereHitDistance && sourceSphereHitDistance < hits[index].uvwt.s3)\n            {\n                rays[index].extra.y = 0;\n                hits[index].primid = -1;\n                return;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n\n#ifdef ENABLE_LISTENER_SPHERE_OCCLUSION\n    for (int i = 0; i < numListeners; ++i)\n    {\n        uint index = i * numRays + rayIndex;\n        float listenerSphereHitDistance = raySphereIntersect(&rays[index], listeners[i], LISTENER_RADIUS);\n        if (0.0f <= listenerSphereHitDistance && listenerSphereHitDistance < hits[index].uvwt.s3)\n        {\n            rays[index].extra.y = 0;\n            hits[index].primid = -1;\n            return;\n        }\n    }\n#endif\n}\n\nkernel void uberShade(uint numListeners, \n                      global float3 const* listeners, \n                      global Ray const* rays, \n                      global Hit const* hits,\n                      uint numSources, \n                      uint numActiveSources,\n                      global Source const* sources, \n                      global int const* sourceIndices,\n                      float irradianceMinDistance,\n                      global float4 const* normals, \n                      global int const* materialIndices, \n                      global Material const* materials,\n                      uint numDiffuseSamples, \n                      global float4 const* diffuseSamples, \n                      uint randomNumber, \n                      global Ray* shadowRays,\n                      global Ray* reflectedRays, \n                      global float4* accumulatedEnergy, \n                      global float* accumulatedDelay,\n                      global float4* image, \n                      global float4* totalEnergy, \n                      global float* totalDelay, \n                      uchar bounceRays,\n                      int bounce,\n                      global int* numRadeonRaysShadowRays)\n{\n    size_t numShadowRays = get_global_size(0);\n    size_t numChunks = max(numListeners, numActiveSources);\n    size_t numPrimaryRays = numShadowRays / numChunks;\n\n    uint rayIndex = (numListeners > 1) ? get_global_id(0) : (get_global_id(0) % numPrimaryRays);\n    uint chunkIndex = get_global_id(0) / numPrimaryRays;\n    uint listenerIndex = (numListeners > 1) ? chunkIndex : 0;\n    uint compactedSourceIndex = (numActiveSources > 1) ? chunkIndex : 0;\n    uint sourceIndex = (numListeners == 1) ? sourceIndices[compactedSourceIndex] : compactedSourceIndex;\n\n    uint compactedShadowRayIndex = get_global_id(0);\n\n    uint shadowRayIndex = (numListeners == 1) ? sourceIndex * numPrimaryRays + rayIndex : compactedShadowRayIndex;\n\n    if (get_global_id(0) == 0) {\n        *numRadeonRaysShadowRays = get_global_size(0);\n    }\n    \n    if (rays[rayIndex].extra.y == 0 || hits[rayIndex].primid < 0) {\n        if (numListeners > 1 || compactedSourceIndex == 0) {\n            reflectedRays[rayIndex].extra = 0;\n        }\n        shadowRays[compactedShadowRayIndex].extra.y = 0;\n        totalEnergy[shadowRayIndex] = (float4) 0.0f;\n        totalDelay[shadowRayIndex] = 0.0f;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    local Rng   rng;\n    local float randomFloat;\n    local uint  randomUint;\n    if (get_local_id(0) == 0) {\n        initRng(randomNumber + rayIndex, &rng);\n        randomFloat = randFloat(&rng);\n        randomUint = randUint(&rng);\n    }\n    barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE);\n\n    bool skipRay = false;\n\n    float3 rayDirection = rays[rayIndex].d.xyz;\n\n    int hitIndex = hits[rayIndex].primid;\n    float hitDistance = hits[rayIndex].uvwt.s3;\n\n#ifdef ENABLE_LISTENER_HEAD_FADE\n    if (hitDistance <= LISTENER_RADIUS)\n    {\n        skipRay = true;\n    }\n#endif\n\n    float3 hitPoint = rays[rayIndex].o.xyz + hitDistance * rayDirection;\n    float3 hitNormal = normals[hitIndex].xyz;\n    if (dot(hitNormal, rayDirection) > 0.0f) {\n        hitNormal = -hitNormal;\n    }\n\n    float3 sourcePosition = sources[sourceIndex].coordinates.origin.xyz;\n\n    float4 hitMaterialCoefficients = (float4) (materials[materialIndices[hitIndex]].absorptionLow, \n        materials[materialIndices[hitIndex]].absorptionMid, materials[materialIndices[hitIndex]].absorptionHigh, \n        materials[materialIndices[hitIndex]].scattering);\n    float hitMaterialScattering = materials[materialIndices[hitIndex]].scattering;\n\n    float hitToSourceDistance = distance(hitPoint, sourcePosition);\n    float4 hitToSource = (float4) (normalize(sourcePosition - hitPoint), 0.0f);\n\n    if (dot(hitToSource.xyz, hitNormal) < 0.0f) \n    {\n        skipRay = true;\n    }\n\n#ifdef ENABLE_SOURCE_RADIANCE_CHECK\n    if (hitToSourceDistance <= irradianceMinDistance)\n    {\n        skipRay = true;\n    }\n#endif\n\n    if (skipRay) {\n        shadowRays[compactedShadowRayIndex].extra.y = 0;\n        totalEnergy[shadowRayIndex] = (float4) 0.0f;\n        totalDelay[shadowRayIndex] = 0.0f;\n    } else {\n        shadowRays[compactedShadowRayIndex].d = hitToSource;\n        shadowRays[compactedShadowRayIndex].o = (float4) (hitPoint + RAY_SURFACE_OFFSET * hitToSource.xyz, hitToSourceDistance);\n        shadowRays[compactedShadowRayIndex].extra = (int2) (0xffffffff, 1);\n\n        float4 energy = (1.0f / PI) * hitMaterialScattering * max(0.0f, dot(hitNormal, hitToSource.xyz));\n        energy += ((SPECULAR_EXPONENT + 2.0f) / (8.0f * PI)) * (1.0f - hitMaterialScattering) * \n            pow(fabs(dot(normalize(hitToSource.xyz - rayDirection), hitNormal)), SPECULAR_EXPONENT);\n        energy *= evaluateDirectivity(hitPoint, sources[sourceIndex].coordinates, sources[sourceIndex].directivity);\n        energy *= pointSourceIrradiance(hitToSourceDistance, irradianceMinDistance);\n        energy *= accumulatedEnergy[rayIndex] * (float4) (1.0f - hitMaterialCoefficients);\n\n        float delayTerm = (hitDistance + hitToSourceDistance) / SPEED_OF_SOUND;\n\n        totalEnergy[shadowRayIndex] = ((4.0f * PI) / numPrimaryRays) * energy;\n        totalDelay[shadowRayIndex] = delayTerm + accumulatedDelay[rayIndex] - \n            (distance(sourcePosition, listeners[listenerIndex]) / SPEED_OF_SOUND);\n    }\n\n    barrier(CLK_GLOBAL_MEM_FENCE);\n\n    if (numListeners > 1 || compactedSourceIndex == 0) {\n        accumulatedDelay[rayIndex] += hitDistance / SPEED_OF_SOUND;\n        accumulatedEnergy[rayIndex] *= ((float4) 1.0f - hitMaterialCoefficients);\n\n        float4 reflectedDirection = (float4) 0.0f;\n        if (randomFloat < hitMaterialCoefficients.s3) {\n            uint sampleIndex = randomUint % numDiffuseSamples;\n            float3 transformedDiffuseSample = transformHemisphereSample(diffuseSamples[sampleIndex].xyz, hitNormal);\n            reflectedDirection = (float4) (transformedDiffuseSample, 0.0f);\n        } else {\n            reflectedDirection = (float4) (reflect(rayDirection, hitNormal), 0.0f);\n        }\n\n        reflectedRays[rayIndex].d = reflectedDirection;\n        reflectedRays[rayIndex].o = (float4) (hitPoint + RAY_SURFACE_OFFSET * reflectedDirection.xyz, FLT_MAX);\n        reflectedRays[rayIndex].extra = (int2) (0xffffffff, 1);\n    }\n}\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Image Accumulation Kernel\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nkernel void gatherImage(uint numActiveSources, global int* sourceIndices, global int* occluded, \n    global float4* totalEnergy, global float4* image)\n{\n    size_t rayIndex = get_global_id(0);\n    size_t numRays = get_global_size(0);\n\n    for (uint i = 0; i < numActiveSources; ++i) {\n        int sourceIndex = sourceIndices[i];\n        if (occluded[i * numRays + rayIndex] < 0) {\n            image[rayIndex] += VISUALIZATION_SCALE * (numRays / (4.0f * PI)) * totalEnergy[sourceIndex * numRays + rayIndex];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nkernel void accumulateImage(global float4* image, int numFramesDrawn, global float4* accumulatedImage)\n{\n    uint index = get_global_id(0);\n    accumulatedImage[index] = ((accumulatedImage[index] * numFramesDrawn) + image[index]) / (numFramesDrawn + 1);\n}\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Energy Field Accumulation Kernel\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#define NUM_BANDS                   3\n#define NUM_BINS                    256\n#define BIN_DURATION                0.01f\n#define NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS        2                     // Number of copies for scrambling (tunable)\n#define WEIGHTEDTIME_SCALE          1e+1f \n\nkernel void accumulateHistograms(float scale, global float* totalEnergy, global float* totalDelay, uint offset,\n    uint compactedOffset, global int* occluded, global float* shCoefficients, global int *energy, \n    global int *weightedTime, global int *weightedTimeSquared)\n{\n\t// The number of global work-items for this kernel is #rays * #bands * #channels.\n\t// The number of local work-items for this kernel is #bins * 1 * 1. Here, #bins is a compile-time constant.\n\t// This kernel runs in three stages:\n\t//\t1.\tEach work-group operates on a subset of rays, and accumulates their energy into one of multiple\n\t//\t\tlocal-memory histograms.\n\t//\t2.\tEach work-group adds all of its local-memory histograms together.\n\t//\t3.\tThe work-groups cooperate and combine their local-memory histograms into a global-memory histogram.\n\n    uint rayIndex = get_global_id(0);\n    uint band = get_global_id(1);\n    uint channel = get_global_id(2);\n\n    size_t numRays = get_global_size(0);\n\n    bool isOccluded = (occluded[compactedOffset + rayIndex] >= 0);\n\n\t// FIXME: shouldn't this be just get_local_id(0)?\n    const int localIndex = get_local_id(1) * get_local_size(0) + get_local_id(0);\n\n\t// Each work-group stores NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS histograms in local memory. These are interleaved, i.e.,\n\t// bin i of histogram j is at index (NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS * i + j) in the buffer. We use multiple local-memory\n\t// histograms to reduce the chance that an atomic_add leads to contention (see below for details).\n    local int localEnergy[NUM_BINS * NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS];\n    local int localWeightedTime[NUM_BINS * NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS];\n    local int localWeightedTimeSquared[NUM_BINS * NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS];\n\n\t// These base pointers are used in stage 2 of the kernel. See below for details.\n    local int* workItemEnergy = localEnergy + mul24(localIndex, NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS);\n    local int* workItemWeightedTime = localWeightedTime + mul24(localIndex, NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS);\n    local int* workItemWeightedTimeSquared = localWeightedTimeSquared + mul24(localIndex, NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS);\n\n\t// Initialize all local-memory histograms to zero.\n    for (int i = 0; i < NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS; i++) {\n        workItemEnergy[i] = 0.0f;\n        workItemWeightedTime[i] = 0.0f;\n        workItemWeightedTimeSquared[i] = 0.0f;\n    }\n\n    barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE);\n\n\t// Stage 1\n\t// Each work-item processes one ray. If it is not occluded (i.e., it carries non-zero energy), the energy is added\n\t// to one of the local-memory histograms for the work-group. These adds need to be atomic, since multiple rays\n\t// being processed in the same work-group may write to the same bin of the same histogram. The contention\n\t// due to atomic_adds can be reduced by increasing NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS, at the cost of increased local memory\n\t// usage.\n    if (!isOccluded)\n    {\n\t\t// Adjacent work-items in a work-group do not use the same local-memory histogram. A work-item with local\n\t\t// index i writes to local-memory histogram (i % NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS).\n\t\t// When calculating the bin index, bin index i is mapped to index  NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS * i in the\n\t\t// local-memory buffer. This is because the histograms are interleaved.\n        local int* shiftedLocalEnergy = localEnergy + localIndex % NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS;\n        local int* shiftedLocalWeightedTime = localWeightedTime + localIndex % NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS;\n        local int* shiftedLocalWeightedTimeSquared = localWeightedTimeSquared + localIndex % NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS;\n\n        global float* rayEnergy = (global float*) (&totalEnergy[(offset + rayIndex) * 4]);\n\n        float time = totalDelay[offset + rayIndex];\n        uint bin = convert_uint_sat(floor(time / BIN_DURATION)) * NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS;\n\n        float energyValue = scale * rayEnergy[band] * shCoefficients[channel * numRays + rayIndex];\n        int quantizedEnergyValue = convert_int_sat(floor(energyValue));\n        atomic_add(shiftedLocalEnergy + bin, quantizedEnergyValue);\n\n        float weightedTimeValue = energyValue * (time * WEIGHTEDTIME_SCALE);\n        int quantizedWeightedTimeValue = convert_int_sat(floor(weightedTimeValue));\n        atomic_add(shiftedLocalWeightedTime + bin, quantizedWeightedTimeValue);\n\n        float weightedTimeSquaredValue = weightedTimeValue * (time * WEIGHTEDTIME_SCALE);\n        int quantizedWeightedTimeSquaredValue = convert_int_sat(floor(weightedTimeSquaredValue));\n        atomic_add(shiftedLocalWeightedTimeSquared + bin, quantizedWeightedTimeSquaredValue);\n    }\n\n    barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE);\n\n\t// Stage 2\n\t// Each work-item processes one bin. The corresponding bins for all local-memory histograms are added, and the\n\t// result is stored in a private variable. No atomic operations or barriers are required here, since each work-item\n\t// operates on independent data.\n    int accumulatedEnergy = 0;\n    int accumulatedWeightedTime = 0;\n    int accumulatedWeightedTimeSquared = 0;\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < NUM_LOCAL_HISTOGRAMS; i++) {\n        accumulatedEnergy += workItemEnergy[i];\n        accumulatedWeightedTime += workItemWeightedTime[i];\n        accumulatedWeightedTimeSquared += workItemWeightedTimeSquared[i];\n    }\n\n\t// Stage 3\n\t// Each work-item processes one bin. The summed values from the local-memory histograms are added to the corresponding\n\t// bin in a global-memory histogram. Here, atomic_adds must be used, because multiple work-groups may be trying to\n\t// write to the same global-memory bin at the same time.\n    atomic_add(energy + channel*NUM_BANDS*NUM_BINS + band*NUM_BINS + localIndex, accumulatedEnergy);\n    atomic_add(weightedTime + channel*NUM_BANDS*NUM_BINS + band*NUM_BINS + localIndex, accumulatedWeightedTime);\n    atomic_add(weightedTimeSquared + channel*NUM_BANDS*NUM_BINS + band*NUM_BINS + localIndex, accumulatedWeightedTimeSquared);\n}\n\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Reconstruction Kernels\n// --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#define ENERGY_THRESHOLD            1e-7f\n#define MIN_VARIANCE                1e-5f\n#define NUM_WORK_ITEM_SAMPLES       32\n#define WORK_GROUP_SIZE\t\t\t\t64\n\nkernel void applyIIRFilter(global IIR* filters, \n                           global float* impulseResponse, \n\t\t\t\t\t\t   uint numBins, \n\t\t\t\t\t\t   uint samplesPerBin,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t   uint numSamples)\n{\n    size_t band = get_global_id(0);\n    size_t channel = get_global_id(1);\n    size_t numBands = get_global_size(0);\n    size_t numChannels = get_global_size(1);\n    size_t batch = get_global_id(2);\n\t\t\n\tlocal float localSamples[(NUM_WORK_ITEM_SAMPLES * WORK_GROUP_SIZE) + NUM_WORK_ITEM_SAMPLES]; \n\n\tconst int localIndex = get_local_id(1) * get_local_size(0) + get_local_id(0);\n\tlocal float* workItemSamples = &localSamples[localIndex * NUM_WORK_ITEM_SAMPLES];\n\n    global float* signal = &impulseResponse[(batch * numChannels * numBands * numSamples) + (channel * numBands * numSamples) + (band * numSamples)];\n\n\tfloat xm1 = 0.0f;\n\tfloat xm2 = 0.0f;\n\tfloat ym1 = 0.0f;\n\tfloat ym2 = 0.0f;\n\n    global IIR* filter = &filters[band];\n\n    float a1 = filter->a1;\n    float a2 = filter->a2;\n    float b0 = filter->b0;\n    float b1 = filter->b1;\n    float b2 = filter->b2;\n\n\tfor (uint i = 0; i < (numBins * samplesPerBin); i += NUM_WORK_ITEM_SAMPLES)\n    {\n\t\tfor (uint j = 0; j < NUM_WORK_ITEM_SAMPLES; ++j)\n\t\t{\t\t\n\t\t\tworkItemSamples[j] = signal[i + j];\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tfor (uint j = 0; j < NUM_WORK_ITEM_SAMPLES; ++j)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tfloat x = workItemSamples[j];\n\t\t\tfloat y = (b0 * x) + (b1 * xm1) + (b2 * xm2) - (a1 * ym1) - (a2 * ym2);\n\n\t\t\txm2 = xm1;\n\t\t\txm1 = x;\n\t\t\tym2 = ym1;\n\t\t\tym1 = y;\n\n\t\t\tworkItemSamples[j] = y;\n\t\t}\n\t\t\n\t\tfor (uint j = 0; j < NUM_WORK_ITEM_SAMPLES; ++j)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tsignal[i + j] = workItemSamples[j]; \t\t\n\t\t}\t\t\n    }\n}\n\nkernel void reconstructImpulseResponse(global int* energy, \n                                       global int* weightedTime, \n                                       global int* weightedTimeSquared, \n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t   uint samplingRate, \n                                       uint samplesPerBin,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t   uint numSamples, \n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t   global float* airAbsorption, \n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t   global IIR* filters, \n                                       global float* impulseResponse, \n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t   float scale)\n{\n    size_t bin = get_global_id(0);\n    size_t band = get_global_id(1);\n    size_t channel = get_global_id(2);\n\tsize_t numBins = get_global_size(0);\n    size_t numBands = get_global_size(1);\n    size_t numChannels = get_global_size(2);\n\n    global float* impulseResponseBin = &impulseResponse[(channel * numBands * numSamples) + (band * numSamples) + (bin * samplesPerBin)];\n\n    float e0 = (float)energy[0*numBands*NUM_BINS + band*NUM_BINS + bin] / scale;\n    float e = (float)energy[channel*numBands*NUM_BINS + band*NUM_BINS + bin] / scale;\n    float wt = (float)weightedTime[channel*numBands*NUM_BINS + band*NUM_BINS + bin] / (scale*WEIGHTEDTIME_SCALE);\n    float wts = (float)weightedTimeSquared[channel*numBands*NUM_BINS + band*NUM_BINS + bin] / (scale*WEIGHTEDTIME_SCALE*WEIGHTEDTIME_SCALE);\n\n    if (fabs(e) < ENERGY_THRESHOLD)\n    {\n        for (int i = 0; i < samplesPerBin; ++i)\n            impulseResponseBin[i] = 0.0f;\n    }\n    else\n    {\n        float tMean = wt / e;\n        float tVariance = max(MIN_VARIANCE, (wts / e) - (tMean * tMean));\n\n        int sample = bin * samplesPerBin;\n        float binEnergy = 0.0f;\n\n        float t = sample / (float)samplingRate;\n        float dt = 1.0f / (float)samplingRate;\n\n        float g = exp(-((t - tMean) * (t - tMean)) / (2.0f * tVariance));\n        float dg = exp(-(dt * ((2.0f * (t - tMean)) + dt)) / (2.0f * tVariance));\n        float ddg = exp(-(dt * dt) / tVariance);\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < samplesPerBin; ++i)\n        {\n            impulseResponseBin[i] *= g;\n            binEnergy += impulseResponseBin[i] * impulseResponseBin[i];\n            g *= dg;\n            dg *= ddg;\n        }\n\n        float normalization = e / sqrt(e0 * sqrt(4.0f * PI));\n\n        normalization *= exp(-0.5f * airAbsorption[band] * SPEED_OF_SOUND * ((bin + 0.5f) * samplesPerBin * (1.0f / samplingRate)));\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < samplesPerBin; ++i)\n            impulseResponseBin[i] *= normalization;\n    }\n}\n\nkernel void combineBandpassedImpulseResponse(uint numSamples, \n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t uint numBands, \n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t uint paddedNumSamples,\n                                             global float* bandImpulseResponses, \n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t global float* impulseResponse)\n{\n    size_t sample = get_global_id(0);\n    size_t channel = get_global_id(1);\n    size_t batch = get_global_id(2);\n\tsize_t numChannels = get_global_size(1);\n\n\tfloat value = 0.0f;\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < numBands; ++i)\n        value += bandImpulseResponses[(batch * numChannels * numBands * numSamples) + (channel * numBands * numSamples) + (i * numSamples) + sample];\n\n\timpulseResponse[(batch * numChannels * paddedNumSamples) + (channel * paddedNumSamples) + sample] = value;\n}\n
